groups.name: New Zealand
groups.tagline: 8 Nights, 9 Days · Auckland, Rotorua, Queenstown, Christchurch

offer.summary: 9 days trip built around Auckland, Rotorua, Queenstown, Christchurch at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Oceania journeys we shape by hand through Oceania, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Enjoy sweeping harbour views, climb volcanic Mount Eden and experience the city's lively waterfront and island escapes.
Witness erupting geysers, bubbling mud pools and vibrant thermal landscapes alongside rich Māori culture.
Embrace breathtaking alpine scenery with Lake Wakatipu, thrilling adventures, scenic hikes and world-class bungy experiences.
Stroll through the tranquil Botanic Gardens, drift along the Avon River and discover the charm of New Zealand's Garden City.

groups.name: Australia
groups.tagline: 9 Nights, 10 Days · Melbourne, Philip Island, Brisbane, Sydney, Gold Coast, Cairns

offer.summary: 10 days trip built around Melbourne, Philip Island, Brisbane, Sydney, Gold Coast, Cairns at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Australia journeys we shape by hand through Australia, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Explore Federation Square, Queen Victoria Market, the Royal Botanic Gardens and the city's vibrant arts and café culture.
Watch little penguins return at sunset and encounter koalas, seals and rugged coastal scenery.
Enjoy relaxed riverside living through South Bank, Howard Smith Wharves, Mt Coot-tha and scenic city walks.
Take in the timeless beauty of the Opera House and Harbour Bridge along the sparkling waterfront.
Embrace sun, surf and entertainment across Surfers Paradise, world-class theme parks and the lush hinterland.
Dive into the Great Barrier Reef and explore the ancient Daintree Rainforest, where two World Heritage wonders meet.

groups.name: Fiji
groups.tagline: 6 Nights, 7 Days · Suva, Lautoka, Nadi, Nausori, Sigatoka

offer.summary: 7 days trip built around Suva, Lautoka, Nadi, Nausori, Sigatoka at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Oceania journeys we shape by hand through Oceania, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Explore Fiji's cultural capital through the Fiji Museum, vibrant markets, colonial landmarks and lush Thurston Gardens.
Discover the "Sugar City" through its colourful market, tropical coastline and nearby Koroyanitu National Heritage Park.
Experience Fiji's welcoming gateway with Sri Siva Subramaniya Temple, the Garden of the Sleeping Giant and easy access to island escapes.
Venture beyond the town into the scenic Nausori Highlands, where rolling valleys, villages and waterfalls reveal Fiji's peaceful interior.
Follow the Coral Coast to the dramatic Sigatoka Sand Dunes, golden beaches and the lush landscapes of the Sigatoka River Valley.
